body_markdown:
IFF’s channel partnerships close the gap for home care manufacturers, delivering enzyme[innovation](https://www.iff.com/home-care/fabric-care/enzyme-innovation-biotech-fabric-care/) to help companies that have historically operated without access to top-tier[enzyme science](https://www.iff.com/home-care/fabric-care/laundry-enzymes/) . Through channel partners like IndSpyre Solutions in North America and IMCD across Europe and Latin America, IFF has built a distribution network that circulates expertise, not just products.


## **Quality that Travels, Speed When it Counts**


Internal validation testing is the moment of truth for IFF customers bringing a new home care or industrial & institutional formulation to market. IFF’s process eliminates surprises during this important stage. Years of methodology alignment, shared training, and mutual investment with channel partners ensures the same tests are run under the same conditions that IFF would run in its own labs, guaranteeing the integrity of the results for each customer.


The clock is always running in the home care market, with a typical product facing roughly a one-year development window before the market moves on to something new.[IndSpyre](https://www.indspyre.com/) and[IMCD](https://www.imcdgroup.com/) work proactively to provide their customers with validated solutions and starting formulations benchmarked against leading brand tiers, rather than waiting for challenges to react to. Expertise travels smoothly throughout this network, uncovering trends in isolated supply chains in days, rather than months, offering opportunities to provide solutions sooner.


## **Regional Labs, Global Standards**


Behind every validated enzyme-powered home care[formulation](https://www.iff.com/home-care/broader-reach-better-science/) is rigorous lab work. IFF’s channel partners extend this rigor across the globe. IndSpyre’s 3,000 sq ft North American home care lab is built to IFF standards. IMCD’s newly opened Cologne, Germany facility dedicates 200 sqm to laundry and dish development, reproducing market-relevant methods (e.g., IKW, Ecolabel). And in Brazil, IMCD has become a reference for enzymatic cleaning solutions in a region that was previously without dedicated enzyme support, providing Latin America customers the same quality of technical service as customers anywhere in the world.


## **A Complete and Trusted Path to Market**


IFF can recommend the right enzyme, but a finished product needs much more, including surfactants,[polymers](https://www.iff.com/science/deb/) ,[stabilizers](https://www.iff.com/home-care/solving-the-stability-challenge-for-laundry-enzymes/) , bio-based options, third-party certifications, and a formulation plan that holds together across the whole ingredient list. IFF’s channel partners add complete, tested formulations covering every ingredient on the back of the bottle, with the data to back it up, plus the expertise to make sure sustainability claims actually hold.


Channel partnerships rest on mutual expertise and transparent investment. IFF provides enzyme science and application testing, while channel partners contribute formulation knowledge, market access, and[broader](https://www.iff.com/home-care/broader-reach-better-science/) relationships. Both sides own the results, sustained by regular reporting and shared customer days that keep methods aligned across the global network. Whether it’s a boutique brand building its first laundry formula or a regional manufacturer with no lab of its own, IFF’s channel partners help close the gap between innovation and impact.
